title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: declarative agents ground answers in scanned PDFs from SharePoint
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap description and both control paths and commands are supported. Microsoft's licensing pages disagree about whether SharePoint grounding always requires a Copilot licence; the briefing should acknowledge the documented pay-as-you-go alternative. Minor corrections also concern checklist controls missing from the table and an action rating that should reflect the launched status.
